extraction.name: cleaned YODAS
extraction.description: A cleaned version of the YODAS dataset containing 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages, created by realigning audio and text, and filtering based on LID and CTC confidence scores.
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was crawled from the web as part of the YODAS dataset pipeline.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Unsegmented long-form recordings accompanied by text transcriptions with timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data-cleaning pipeline consists of three steps: realigning audio and text using CTC segmentation, filtering data based on language identification (LID) results, and filtering data based on CTC confidence scores.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution across languages is highly imbalanced, with English constituting the largest share and many other languages being underrepresented.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The raw data may contain annotation errors, mismatched language labels, and misalignment between audio and text.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating speech foundation models on multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), language identification (LID), and speech translation (ST).

name.evidence: yielding a dataset with 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages.

description.evidence: To address this, we develop a scalable data-cleaning pipeline using public toolkits, yielding a dataset with 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages.

license.evidence: YODAS publicly releases audio files in a Creative Commons license instead of links to original sources

creator.evidence: Yifan Peng1, Muhammad Shakeel2, Yui Sudo2, William Chen1, Jinchuan Tian1, Chyi-Jiunn Lin1, Shinji Watanabe1

rai:dataCollection.evidence: YODAS establishes a scalable pipeline to crawl data from the web.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: YODAS establishes a scalable pipeline to crawl data from the web.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: YODAS provides unsegmented long-form recordings, each of them is accompanied by a list of text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: Our data-cleaning pipeline consists of three steps: (1) realign audio and text using a pre-trained OWSM-CTC model, (2) filter data based on LID results, and (3) filter data based on CTC confidence scores.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: Similar to the raw YODAS data, the distribution across languages is highly imbalanced. English constitutes the largest share, whereas many other languages continue to be underrepresented.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: The raw YODAS data has not undergone a rigorous cleaning process and may contain annotation errors [24]. Common issues include mismatched language labels and misalignment between audio and text.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: We evaluate our OWSM v4 models on multilingual ASR, LID, and ST benchmarks using greedy decoding unless otherwise specified.
